findings.claim: The signature-read increment must be installed, guardedly deployed to the existing AWS test App Runner service, and positively verified through authenticated HTTP before the task is complete.
findings.observed: The task checkpoint marks deployment/live verification step 5b BLOCKED, states the final candidate was NOT DEPLOYED, and records that no bearer retrieval or HTTP verification occurred; the deployed image was confirmed to lack the signature allowlist.
findings.rationale: The caller's task contract explicitly says source/local green is insufficient and requires DEPLOYED plus LIVE-FUNCTION-VERIFIED status in this same delivery. The supplied material therefore establishes an undelivered required behavior despite the completed source implementation and valid RED/GREEN proof.
findings.required: Complete the guarded in-place rollout of the final candidate to the existing wonderfulkb-ingest AWS test target, verify the deployed digest/revision and healthy operation, then perform the bounded authenticated positive signature-observation HTTP checks and record the truthful deployed/live evidence.
